Brand and aesthetic constraints:
- Strictly LIGHT THEME only.
- Primary brand accent: Teal #0F766E and deep teal #0d5f58 only. NO purple, NO violet, NO dark-mode surfaces.
- Clean neutrals: Pure white #FFFFFF, soft grayish background #F5F7F8, ink dark text #0B1218, muted text #5C6B76, borders #E3E9ED, soft mint accent washes (#E6F4F1, #CCECE6).
- Font: Plus Jakarta Sans. Crisp typography, refined data density, clean B2B SaaS finish. Strictly NO emoji anywhere (use clean SVGs/lucide-style icons).

Navigation Chrome (Semrush-style Dual-Rail Left Navigation with Settings Suite ACTIVE):
- Primary Far-Left Icon Rail (width ~72px, bg white, border-r #E3E9ED):
  * Logo mark at top: GeoLens mark (teal compass/lens icon).
  * Suite navigation icons: Analysis, Brand, Monitor, Results, Settings.
  * Settings icon is ACTIVE (highlighted with soft teal tint / mint container #E6F4F1, text/icon #0F766E).
  * Bottom rail: Telemetry quota widget or Collapse icon (<< Collapse).
- Secondary Left Navigation Rail (width ~240px, bg white or #FBFDFD, border-r #E3E9ED):
  * Suite Header: "SETTINGS", subtitle/badge "Workspace".
  * Section ENTITY & SETUP:
    - Profile (icon, link)
    - Brands (icon, badge '5')
    - Topics & tags (ACTIVE state: solid teal #0F766E background or bold pill with soft mint fill #E6F4F1 + teal #0F766E text and indicator dot, prompt count '18')
    - Channels (icon, badge '4 LLMs')
  * Section SECURITY & BILLING:
    - Billing (icon, badge 'Pro')
    - API keys (icon, dot indicator)
    - SSO & SAML (icon, badge 'SAML 2.0')
  * Bottom quota pill: Telemetry / Prompt Quota 28.4% (1,420 / 5,000 queries, Upgrade).

Global Top Header Bar:
- Breadcrumb / Entity switcher: "nike.com (Global)" dropdown | Settings > Topics & tags [Prompt taxonomy badge in soft mint]
- Status pill: "Telemetry Active (4 Engines)" with green dot
- Search bar: "Search topics, tags, queries..."
- Actions: Notifications, Help, User Avatar "GL" in teal circle.

Main Content Area — Topics & tags:
1. Header Section:
   - Title: "Topics & tags" accompanied by badge "Prompt taxonomy" (soft mint background #E6F4F1, teal text #0F766E, rounded-full, border #CCECE6).
   - Subtitle: "Organize prompts and discovery themes for filtering and reporting across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews."
   - Top action buttons: "+ Add tag" (secondary white button with border #E3E9ED, text #0B1218) and "+ Add topic" (primary solid teal button #0F766E, text white, icon +).

2. KPI Cards Row (4 cards):
   - Card 1: "ACTIVE TOPICS" -> 18 (badge "+3 this sprint"), subtitle "Core thematic taxonomy categories".
   - Card 2: "TAXONOMY TAGS" -> 64 (badge "Active across 4 LLMs"), subtitle "Granular attributes, intent & lifecycle".
   - Card 3: "LINKED PROMPTS" -> 280 (badge "92% prompt coverage"), subtitle "Prompts mapped to ≥1 topic".
   - Card 4: "UNASSIGNED PROMPTS" -> 24 (badge "Action needed", amber pill), subtitle "Discovered queries missing topic tags".

3. Main Interactive Workspace (Two-column layout):
   - Left / Main Area (65% width): Topics Hierarchy & Management
     * Filter & search bar: Quick search input, status filter ("All Topics (18)", "Active", "Archived"), sort dropdown ("By Prompt Volume").
     * Topics Data Table / Card List:
       - Row 1: "Modern Relational Data Model" | Description: "Relational architecture, PostgreSQL schemas, custom objects" | Prompts: 34 prompts | Associated Tags: [Relational], [GraphQL], [Custom Objects] | Visibility Score: 74.2% | Actions: Edit, Manage Prompts, Menu (...).
       - Row 2: "Startup & Early Stage CRM" | Description: "Seed to Series A evaluation, YC founder stack comparisons" | Prompts: 42 prompts | Associated Tags: [Startup], [YC-Backing], [Seed-Stage] | Visibility Score: 70.8% | Actions: Edit, Manage Prompts, Menu.
       - Row 3: "Automated Email Sync & Enrichment" | Description: "Zero-configuration inbox sync, bi-directional enrichment" | Prompts: 28 prompts | Associated Tags: [Enrichment], [Sync], [No-BCC] | Visibility Score: 60.5% | Actions: Edit, Manage Prompts, Menu.
       - Row 4: "HubSpot & Salesforce Alternative" | Description: "Head-to-head migration, legacy enterprise displacements" | Prompts: 56 prompts | Associated Tags: [Migration], [Displacement], [Enterprise] | Visibility Score: 30.8% (Critical Gap indicator) | Actions: Edit, Manage Prompts, Menu.
       - Row 5: "Enterprise Security & SOC2 Compliance" | Description: "HIPAA, SOC2 Type II, dedicated SLA, data residency" | Prompts: 19 prompts | Associated Tags: [SOC2], [Security], [Compliance] | Visibility Score: 23.0% (Deficit) | Actions: Edit, Manage Prompts, Menu.
       - Row 6: "Developer API & GraphQL Flexibility" | Description: "Webhook subscriptions, REST/GraphQL rate limits, headless CRM" | Prompts: 31 prompts | Associated Tags: [API], [GraphQL], [Webhooks] | Visibility Score: 74.0% | Actions: Edit, Manage Prompts, Menu.
     * Pagination bar showing 1-6 of 18 topics.

   - Right Column (35% width): Tags Cloud & Taxonomy Knowledge Panel
     * Card A: "Taxonomy Tags Cloud"
       - Subtitle: "Quick-filter tags and frequency counts across queries"
       - Search tags input
       - Tag category filters: "Intent", "Feature", "Segment", "Lifecycle"
       - Tag chips with usage counts: [Relational (48)], [GraphQL (38)], [Migration (56)], [Startup (42)], [Enterprise (36)], [Custom Objects (29)], [SOC2 (19)], [Enrichment (28)], [Pricing (24)], [Zapier-Alts (15)], [Speed (21)], [Salesforce-Killers (18)]
       - Batch action: "Merge Tags", "Create Tag Rule"
     * Card B: "How Topics Feed Platform Workflows"
       - Educational/Architectural guidance card with subtle mint border & icon:
         1. "Prompt Research Discovery" -> Automatically tags newly discovered synthetic inquiries from 4 LLM crawlers into topical clusters.
         2. "Prompt Tracking Telemetry" -> Filters daily AI visibility hit rates and share-of-model dashboards by topic performance.
         3. "Automated Action Routing" -> Maps identified hallucination and schema deficits directly to designated engineering sprint backlogs.
     * Card C: "Taxonomy Health & Unassigned Queue"
       - Alert banner: 24 discovered buyer queries have no assigned topic.
       - Button: "Review Unassigned Prompts (24)" in soft teal outline.

Geospatial Analytics","styleGuidelines":"## Brand & Style

This design system establishes a high-density, analytical workspace engineered for spatial intelligence, enterprise location analysis, and competitive benchmarking. It targets enterprise strategists, data scientists, and operations executives who rely on swift pattern recognition across multi-layered geospatial datasets.

The aesthetic philosophy balances modern architectural restraint with high-functioning utilitarianism. By pairing crisp, structural neutrals with concentrated teal focal points, the interface creates an environment of calm focus and absolute precision. Every element communicates reliability, analytical rigor, and quiet confidence—deliberately avoiding decorative noise, gratuitous gradients, or dark-mode cognitive strain.

## Layout & Spacing

The layout model utilizes a fluid 12-column analytical grid flanked by persistent floating control panels and interactive side inspectors. Spacing adheres to a strict 4px/8px modular cadence.

### Breakpoints & Adaptability
- **Desktop Wide (≥1440px)**: 12-column grid, fluid analytical viewport, 24px gutters, fixed-width tool rails (320px sidebar, 400px inspection pane).
- **Desktop/Laptop (1024px – 1439px)**: 12-column grid, 16px gutters, collapsible secondary drawer, map/chart area claims dominant flex-basis.
- **Tablet (768px – 1023px)**: 8-column layout, inspector panel converts into an absolute-positioned bottom sheet.
- **Mobile (<768px)**: Single-column flow with full-width horizontal-scroll cards, stacked key performance tiles, 16px outer safety margins.

## Elevation & Depth

Visual hierarchy uses crisp, ambient low-blur drop shadows paired with fine boundary lines to maintain clarity across dense spatial layers. 

### Elevation Tiers
- **Tier 0 (Base Surface)**: `#F5F7F8` flat canvas, no shadow.
- **Tier 1 (Cards, Data Panels, Metrics)**: Pure `#FFFFFF`, `border: 1px solid #E3E9ED`, `box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(11, 18, 24, 0.04), 0 1px 2px rgba(11, 18, 24, 0.02)`.
- **Tier 2 (Hovered Cards, Dropdowns, Segment Popovers)**: `#FFFFFF`, `border: 1px solid #E3E9ED`, `box-shadow: 0 4px 12px -2px rgba(11, 18, 24, 0.06), 0 2px 6px -1px rgba(11, 18, 24, 0.03)`.
- **Tier 3 (Floating Map Controllers, Modals, Flyouts)**: `#FFFFFF`, `border: 1px solid #E3E9ED`, `box-shadow: 0 12px 28px -4px rgba(11, 18, 24, 0.08), 0 4px 10px -2px rgba(11, 18, 24, 0.04)`.

## Components

### Buttons
- **Primary Action**: Solid `#0F766E` background, `#FFFFFF` bold text, 8px border radius, 0 1px 2px shadow. Hover: `#115E59`. Active: `#134E4A`.
- **Secondary Action**: `#FFFFFF` background, `#0B1218` text, 1px `#E3E9ED` border. Hover: `#F0FDF4` tint, border shifts to `#0F766E`.
- **Tertiary / Utility**: Ghost button with `#5C6B76` text. Hover: `#F5F7F8` fill, `#0B1218` text.

### Cards & Analytics Panels
- Standardized with pure `#FFFFFF` background, 12px or 16px corner radius, and 1px `#E3E9ED` perimeter stroke. 
- Headers feature uppercase `#5C6B76` micro-labels (`label-md`) coupled with large `#0B1218` numeric readouts.

### Chips & Filter Pills
- **Neutral State**: `#FFFFFF` background, 1px `#E3E9ED` border, `#5C6B76` text, 6px radius.
- **Active / Selected State**: `#ECFDF5` background, `#0F766E` text, 1px `#0F766E` border.

- **Checkboxes & Radios**: 16px square/round with 1px `#E3E9ED` border. Checked: `#0F766E` fill with `#FFFFFF` check/dot indicator.

### Data Tables & Geospatial Lists
- Alternating row interaction: Pure `#FFFFFF` resting, transitioning to `#F0FDF4` on pointer hover.
- Row separators: 1px solid `#E3E9ED`.
- Table head: `#F5F7F8` background with uppercase `label-md` tracking in `#5C6B76`.

## Brand & Style

This design system establishes a high-density, analytical workspace engineered for spatial intelligence, enterprise location analysis, and competitive benchmarking. It targets enterprise strategists, data scientists, and operations executives who rely on swift pattern recognition across multi-layered geospatial datasets.

The aesthetic philosophy balances modern architectural restraint with high-functioning utilitarianism. By pairing crisp, structural neutrals with concentrated teal focal points, the interface creates an environment of calm focus and absolute precision. Every element communicates reliability, analytical rigor, and quiet confidence—deliberately avoiding decorative noise, gratuitous gradients, or dark-mode cognitive strain.

## Colors

The palette operates under a strict single-mode light paradigm, utilizing cool atmospheric tones to maintain visual comfort across prolonged analytical sessions. Purple and indigo spectrums are strictly excluded across all interface layers and chart series.

### Semantic & Surface Structure
- **Canvas Root**: `#F5F7F8` serves as the structural floor, giving subtle framing to elevated data panes.
- **Surface Panels**: Pure `#FFFFFF` for primary cards, sidebars, floating inspectors, and modals.
- **Surface Wash & States**: `#F0FDF4` and `#ECFDF5` provide ambient status washes, hover fills, and selection containers.
- **Dividers & Structural Borders**: `#E3E9ED` delivers a crisp, low-weight separation layer.
- **Typography & Icons**:
  - Primary Ink: `#0B1218` (high-contrast, anti-aliased legibility).
  - Muted Metadata: `#5C6B76` (secondary labels, axes, table metadata).
  - Disabled/Ghost: `#94A3B8`.

### Categorical & Data Visualization Engine
- **Primary Metric / Core Entity**: Deep Teal (`#0F766E`)
- **Benchmark / Competitor 1**: Sky Blue (`#0284C7`)
- **Delta Alert / Competitor 2**: Vivid Coral (`#F97316`)
- **Baseline / Competitor 3**: Slate Grey (`#94A3B8`)
- **Secondary Status Anchors**: Error `#E11D48`, Success `#10B981`.

## Typography

Plus Jakarta Sans powers the entire typographic scale. Numeric figures and data density are prioritized through medium and semibold weights, ensuring clear scanning in tables, geo-inspectors, and summary metrics.

Display and headline styles leverage tighter tracking (`-0.02em` to `-0.03em`) to anchor dashboards with executive authority. Body and label weights sit firmly at `500` and `600`, preventing light strokes from dissolving against tinted washes or light neutral backgrounds. Tabular numbers (`font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`) must be activated globally for chart axes, spatial coordinates, and tabular metrics.

## Layout & Spacing

The layout model utilizes a fluid 12-column analytical grid flanked by persistent floating control panels and interactive side inspectors. Spacing adheres to a strict 4px/8px modular cadence.

I have designed and generated the **Settings — Topics & tags** screen for **GeoLens** (`GeoLens — Settings / Topics & tags`), adhering strictly to the brand guidelines, light theme, Semrush-style dual rail navigation, and custom prompt taxonomy architecture.

### Key Highlights:

1. **Brand & Visual Language Continuity:**
   - **Palette:** Dedicated teal brand accent (`#0F766E`) and soft mint wash containers (`#E6F4F1`, `#CCECE6`) with pure white (`#FFFFFF`) surfaces, neutral light grey background (`#F5F7F8`), ink dark body text (`#0B1218`), and refined borders (`#E3E9ED`). Strict absence of purple and zero emojis.
   - **Typography:** Plus Jakarta Sans with clear tabular data hierarchy and status pills.

2. **Semrush-Style Dual-Rail Navigation (Settings Suite Active):**
   - **Far-Left Primary Rail (72px):** GeoLens logo at the top, global suites (*Analysis, Brand, Monitor, Results, Settings*), with **Settings** highlighted in an active soft tile, and collapse trigger at the base.
   - **Secondary Navigation Rail (240px):** Suite header **SETTINGS (Workspace)** with full entity navigation:
     - *Entity & Setup:* Profile, Brands (5), **Topics & tags** (Active state in teal with active indicator dot and prompt counter '18'), Channels (4 LLMs).
     - *Security & Billing:* Billing (Pro), API keys, SSO & SAML (2.0).
     - *Footer:* Telemetry quota widget (28.4% used).

3. **Header & High-Level Taxonomy KPIs:**
   - **Header:** "Topics & tags" paired with the **Prompt taxonomy** mint badge, contextual description, and dual primary actions: secondary `+ Add tag` and primary solid teal `+ Add topic`.
   - **4 Stat Cards:**
     - **Active Topics:** 18 thematic clusters (+3 this sprint)
     - **Taxonomy Tags:** 64 unique tags active across 4 LLMs
     - **Linked Prompts:** 280 of 304 queries (92% coverage)
     - **Unassigned Prompts:** 24 queries requiring triage (amber action-needed badge)

4. **Two-Column Taxonomy Workspace:**
   - **Left / Topics Hierarchy & Management (65%):**
     - Search & filter toolbar (search, topic status tabs, sort by prompt volume, and CSV export).
     - Comprehensive topic rows detailing thematic scope, linked prompt counts, assigned semantic tags (`[Relational]`, `[GraphQL]`, `[Migration]`, `[Enterprise]`), visibility scores with color-coded performance indicators, and granular row actions.
     - Pagination controls (`Showing 1–6 of 18 topics`).
   - **Right / Tags Cloud & Platform Workflow Panel (35%):**
     - **Taxonomy Tags Cloud:** Interactive tag search, category quick-filters (*Intent, Feature, Segment, Lifecycle*), tag chips with live query counts, and batch actions (`Merge Tags`, `Create Tag Rule`).
     - **How Topics Feed Workflows:** Architectural guide demonstrating how topics power *Prompt Research Discovery*, *Prompt Tracking Telemetry*, and *Automated Action Routing*.
     - **Taxonomy Health & Unassigned Queue:** Direct access trigger to review and map the 24 discovered unassigned prompts.
